action_checklist.directive: Immediately remove wedge/jumper and restore safety critical device to automatic mode.
Initiate formal incident investigation into unauthorized override of safety interlock.
Obtain Level 3 management sign-off for any temporary defeat permit.

free_text: Heavy crude oil road tanker truck rolled over into roadside ditch while negotiating sharp turn on wet unpaved oilfield road.
reviewer_notes: Corrective barriers verified on site at Wellsite K-03. Close-out audit filed.

action_checklist.directive: Stop vehicle, engage handbrake, check for fuel leaks, and deploy warning triangles.
Inspect driver defensive driving card, IVMS telemetry data, and sobriety check.
Re-assess road condition hazard rating and restrict speed limits.

free_text: Maintenance crew commenced overhaul of high-pressure motor pump without applying physical LOTO padlock. Circuit breaker remained energized at 6.6kV bus.
reviewer_notes: Corrective barriers verified on site at 33kV Switchgear Room. Close-out audit filed.

action_checklist.directive: Trip upstream breaker, verify zero energy with calibrated detector, and lock out feeder.
Audit all active LOTO permits across facility and conduct stand-down meeting.
Inspect switchgear insulation resistance before re-energizing.

free_text: Entry permit expired while two technicians were cleaning inside hydrocarbon knockout drum. Forced ventilation blower failed without standby person noticing.
reviewer_notes: Corrective barriers verified on site at Heavy Tubular Storage. Close-out audit filed.

action_checklist.directive: Immediately evacuate vessel, deploy forced draft air blowers, and cordon access.
Test top, middle, and bottom levels for O2, LEL, H2S, and CO with calibrated meter.
Station certified standby watch with extraction hoist and SCBA harness.

free_text: Pipe rack stanchion collapsed during offloading of 9-5/8 inch casing pipes, causing two joints to roll towards the walkway.

action_checklist.directive: Halt all hoisting and strictly enforce exclusion boundary on drill floor.

Complete DROPS audit protocol and re-torque all overhead fasteners.

free_text: Hot work permit signed off but designated fire watch left area unattended while torch cutting pipe supports.
reviewer_notes: Corrective barriers verified on site at Header Metering Bay. Close-out audit filed.

action_checklist.directive: Extinguish hot work torches, de-energize grinders, and establish dry powder fire watch.
Clean pooled oil, deploy fire blanket barriers, and verify 0% LEL with gas sniffer.
Re-audit hot work authorization and confirm continuous gas detector placement.

free_text: Scaffolding work platform erected at 14m elevation on flare stack with missing intermediate guardrails and unpinned wooden toe boards.
reviewer_notes: Corrective barriers verified on site at CPF-01 Separation Bay. Close-out audit filed.

action_checklist.directive: Instruct personnel to safely descend and tag scaffolding RED (Do Not Use).
Install double handrails, toe boards, and certified green inspection tag.
Inspect double-lanyard full body harnesses and shock absorbers for all crew.

Install certified aluminum shoring shields before any trench re-entry.
